### Wording question flagged in the brief (judged blind)

The A6 retirement note reads "The clause is likewise no longer in force for the acceptance camera inspection of a sewer lateral replaced whole, which is paid on top of the occurrence cap under its current basis"; the commissioning document's ladder reads "on a line that calls for whole-line work … a sewer lateral adds the sewer commissioning contribution for the acceptance camera inspection of the finished lateral", with "calls for whole-line work" defined from the break count and the last completed repair. In this task the line is a water service line, so the sewer tier is not reached and the number is unaffected. Reading the two together, a careful reader takes the ladder's records test as the trigger for the amount and "replaced whole" as the description of the inspection being carved out of A6; I found no visible sentence that makes the sewer contribution depend on the resolution actually approved rather than the records test. The seam I can see is a scope one: a sewer lateral replaced whole whose records do not "call for whole-line work" would have its acceptance inspection retired from A6 by the note yet earn no contribution under the ladder. Whether the source draws the same boundary is a reveal-side question (Step 3).

### Two-way counter-proof

- Alternatives excluded: section_repair/trenchless (quote line, simulator, A3 table "2 | 1 | the whole line is replaced"); full chargeback share (day 161 in 91–180); galvanized $750.00 (homeplan active, same address, 2240 ≥ 2000); scope rate 0.5/excavation rate 0.5 (both whole-line conditions hold, which outranks the recall tier); no frost amounts (532 is inside 480–629; December); public-way/lawn amounts without offset (recall ≤ 180 days; linked payments 3000.00/335.00).
- "Do only the one thing asked": the hub says the payment "is not fixed until" the request carries the public-way entry and must carry the landscaping entry "before" it is worked out; the request carries neither; approving now leaves the payment fixed in a state the visible rule does not allow. Excluded by the blocked side's own sentences.
- Fall-back 6602.50 ≠ 3947.50.
